phases.name: assert-worker-has-no-credential
argv: import os,subprocess,sys;banned=[k for k in ('GH_TOKEN','GITHUB_TOKEN','GITHUB_PAT','SSH_AUTH_SOCK','GIT_ASKPASS','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','OPENAI_API_KEY') if k in os.environ];print('banned_env_present=',banned);r=subprocess.run(['git','ls-remote','https://github.com/BigBirdReturns/estate.git'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);print('private_clone_rc=',r.returncode);ok = (not banned) and r.returncode!=0;print('CREDENTIAL_ISOLATION_HOLDS' if ok else 'CREDENTIAL_LEAK');sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
